integrity: The included source computes graph families by two separate combinatorial methods, checks all coefficients at n=5,6 by Walsh, direct signed sums and a cycle-and-forest determinant formula, and validates projection norms by a second Walsh transform. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Complete signed Fourier spectra are enumerated only for the stated finite orders, not for all n.
The infinite parity statement is a sufficient invertibility condition; no converse is asserted.
The zero-frequency classification is an exact exhaustive integer computation, not a formal-mechanized proof.
Historical-priority checking is bounded, and an unindexed equivalent computation cannot be excluded.
title: Four-edge Fourier resonance and exact recovery constants for labelled unicyclic graphs
